sources.label: 🧩 Android patches for Morphe: AMOLED themes, ad removal and premium unlocks. Pro
sources.author: hxreborn
patch_list: Applies the system accent colours to the default light and dark themes. Colours refresh when the app restarts, and start from the second launch. Requires Android 12 or later.
Unlocks task lists, callouts, app lock, and the notebook, tag, colour and reminder limits. Requires a signed-in account. The server still enforces storage, attachment size, monographs and SMS 2FA.
